script_text: Stop! Pisces, your water element is feeling every ripple in the sky now. Saturn and Neptune are conjunct in Aries, your 2nd House of money, while the Moon joins them, sharpening every financial feeling. This is not vague anxiety; it is a real test of what you value. Jupiter, your traditional ruler, is retrograde in Leo, your 6th House, trining that Aries stellium and rewarding patient, practical work. In love, Venus in Libra, your 8th House, asks for honest intimacy, not fantasy; taken Pisces should name what they need, while singles attract through calm emotional depth. Career-wise, the 6th House Jupiter blesses disciplined routines, but the 2nd House Saturn-Neptune fog warns against vague budgets or secret deals. Avoid signing anything now until the numbers are crystal clear. Unexpected gift: a Virgo coworker offers a practical fix. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
